QUOTE: "Empty is also a valid result for empty input with `add_special=false`, so a caller cannot tell "failed" from "nothing to encode.""
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says failure is signalled only by an empty vector, so it can't be told apart from a legitimately empty result. It also says the generate paths never check `tokens.empty()`. That "no caller checks" claim is qualified, since the speculative path does check `tokens.size() < 2`. Even so, the core conclusion is stated.
